statement: An isogeny induces an isomorphism on integral ℓ-adic Tate modules iff its kernel has no ℓ-primary part, equivalently iff ℓ does not divide its degree. The same prime-support criterion controls denominators of the rational inverse.
fate: For ℓ different from char(k), the injective map Tℓ(A)→Tℓ(B) induced by an isogeny u:A→B has cokernel canonically isomorphic to ker(u)(k)[ℓ∞]. Thus integral invertibility is equivalent to ℓ not dividing deg(u). Milne I §7 and Lemma10.16 supply the divisibility statement. This prime-support criterion survives the correction of the minimal denominator in C-SA06-265.

statement: The motivic/coniveau level is predicted by Hodge position; the literal rational intersection of Hodge subspaces must be replaced, in general, by its largest rational sub-Hodge structure.
status_on_pages: open on the pages as a conjecture; false as stated for the literal rational-intersection equality, corrected in the author’s later publication

computation.kind: conceptual proof with an exact rational-rank certificate
computation.proof: Takeτ to be the upper-half-plane root ofT³−2 andE=C/(Z+τZ). In V=H1(E,Q)⊗3⊂H3(E³,Q), the map toH^{0,3} has coefficients1,τ,τ²,τ³ andQ-rank3. Its rational kernelK has dimension8−3=5. For a rational vector vanishing of its(0,3)-part forces vanishing of its conjugate(3,0)-part; hence this is the naive rational level1 intersection. A rational Hodge structure of odd weight has even dimension, because its H^{p,q} summands pair withH^{q,p}. ThereforeK is not a sub-Hodge structure. For the real base use the smooth projective abelian varietyX=Res_C/R(E³), of dimension6. InsideH3(X_C,Q), W=V⊕Vbar is an f∞-stable rational Hodge direct summand, and the naive intersection onW isK⊕Kbar. Its dimension10 is not itself a parity contradiction. If the full naive intersection were a sub-Hodge structure, its intersection withW and then its rational Hodge projection toV would makeK a sub-Hodge structure, contradiction. Thus the maximal sub-Hodge structure is the correct necessary target. This exact restriction-and-projection step was independently checked by cote15_middle; the rational rank certificate is parts/cote15_middle/audit/peer_review_C827.json.

This is a correction of the generalized formulation, not a disproof of the usual rational Hodge conjecture. The source date isreceived27October1968, publication1969. statement: For a split semisimple Lie algebra in characteristic0, the root-space decomposition has one-dimensional root spaces, sl2 root triples and the usual opposite-root/Killing pairings; a subalgebra containing the split Cartan is determined by a closed set of roots.
status_on_pages: stated as editorial additions and corrections in reused Lie-algebra leaves

computation.kind: conceptual argument; no numerical computation on which this claim rests
computation.proof: Ifh acts diagonally, a subalgebra containingh decomposes intoh-weight spaces, hence chooses root spacesgα. Closure under brackets forcesα+β whenever it is a root and[gα,gβ]≠0. In characteristic0 that bracket is nonzero in the root-string range. Stability underα↦−α supplies the opposite root triples and a reductive derived part. The Killing pairing has B(gα,gβ)=0unlessα+β=0, byh-invariance.

fate: The precise root-space assertions are classical; Humphreys §8, pp35–40, was read for the root-space and Killing-pairing statements. Calling an abstract subalgebra reductive without specifying its embedding or toral action is stronger than this criterion; the source’s ambient context is essential. computation.kind: conceptual argument; no numerical computation on which this claim rests
computation.proof: From[h,e]=2e,[h,f]=−2f,[e,f]=h, induction givese f^n v_0=n(m−n+1)f^{n−1}v_0. Division byn! yieldse v_n=(m−n+1)v_{n−1}, f v_n=(n+1)v_{n+1}, h v_n=(m−2n)v_n. If the string terminates atq, applying e to f^{q+1}v_0 forcesm=q in characteristic0. The basis is linearly independent because its weights are distinct. Complete reducibility is the separate characteristic0 theorem, not a consequence of this string calculation alone.

statement: An equivariant bilinear map sends simultaneous generalized weight spaces to weightλ+μ for Lie actions and to weightλμ for multiplicative actions, under the stated intertwining identity.
status_on_pages: stated with a proposed editorial formula onscan204

computation.kind: conceptual argument; no numerical computation on which this claim rests
computation.proof: For an additive actionD, the defectD_W−(λ+μ) onB(v,w) equalsB((D_V−λ)v,w)+B(v,(D_{V′}−μ)w). These two induced operators commute; if their nilpotence indices areabyb, their sum is nilpotent ofindex at mosta+b−1 by the binomial theorem. For multiplicative commuting actions the same argument expands(λI+N)⊗(μI+M)−λμI into commuting nilpotent terms. Thus the generalized weights add or multiply as claimed.
